coordinateSystem.origin: body horizontal center at ground level
coordinateSystem.anchorPositions: absolute vehicle-local rest pose; apply frame pivot before rotations
coordinateSystem.seatAnchorMeaning: Actual passenger Entity feet/base origin while riding; not cushion or pelvis. No additional rider offset.
coordinateSystem.yawConvention: Server mountWorld is authoritative: yaw 0 faces +Z; positive 90 degrees faces +X.

modelPartContract.render: ModelPart.render emits 1/16 units. Custom renderer must not apply Humanoid's negative Y/Z scale or +24 model offset.
modelPartContract.rotation: bone rest positions are absolute author blocks; runtime bone pivots below are relative to parent. Apply yaw to turret_yaw and pitch to gun_pitch.
